expectations.text: Actually connects to the cluster and lists collections
expectations.evidence: Response shows actual GET /collections output with 12 specific collections listed including products-us, embeddings-archive, products-en-gb, products-de-de, etc. Raw API data section confirms connection to 94214c31-6930-4f9f-9f33-ec90c15a76c0.eu-west-2-0.aws.cloud.qdrant.io:6333.

expectations.text: Identifies the 10+ products-{locale} collections as an antipattern
expectations.evidence: Root Cause 1 section explicitly identifies '11 separate locale collections (products-{locale}) each holding only 50 points' as an antipattern. States 'This is a classic multi-tenant pattern that should use a single collection with a locale payload field.'

expectations.text: Calculates or mentions the per-collection overhead (12-14 MB each)
expectations.evidence: Step 1 states 'Each collection carries a fixed baseline overhead of 12-14 MB regardless of data volume.' Also calculates '12 x ~13 MB = ~156 MB baseline' in the Collection overhead section.

expectations.text: Recommends consolidating into a single collection with a tenant field
expectations.evidence: Priority 1 recommendation: 'Consolidate 11 locale product collections into one collection with a locale keyword field'. Recommendation table shows this as the top priority action.

expectations.text: Checks collection config (on_disk, quantization) not just collection count
expectations.evidence: Step 2 provides detailed collection config summary including on_disk settings, quantization config for embeddings-archive (always_ram=false), hnsw_config.on_disk, optimizer_status, and payload schema details.
